method: Scratch experiment only. CSV replaces microphone residues at the existing poles, never mechanical/piezo state or any pole.
Fit two independent complex plate/hole strengths per measured A0/T1 and per bridge input using ALL THREE calibrated measured pressure taps. No forced mechanical eigenvector relation.

The symmetric base source predicts equal bridge pair pressure; all-three least squares averages that pair with weight two, plus upper with weight one. Its residual reports unrepresentable bridge asymmetry.
Whole3x2 matrix rank/condition is reported. A rank-deficient bridge-only holdout does not imply the full fit is rank deficient. No independent studio-position validation is available.

For construction relocation, normalized measured complex source proportions stay frozen; target known shape geometry and the unchanged runtime pole enter only Green propagation. Existing runtime common scalar carries total-radiation morph, applied exactly once.
G@Q equals totalVolume*(G@(Q/totalVolume)); this stable product avoids division at source cancellation. Unit-volume surface bases integrate each source to one.
For selected raw85-145Hz modes, authored left x4 is removed exactly once while recovering the existing common scalar. No new low-band scalar attenuation is applied.
Every other residue receives the same real0.1/distance factor, with its phase unchanged. Thus comparison needs the declared single common gain alignment, not independent normalization.
Only own slots0/1 and joint slots133/134 are spatially projected. Other modes including antisymmetric rock retain their measured spatial character apart from common distance.
Green reference exp(s_ref*0.10/c) and target exp(s_target*distance/c) remove a common normal arrival-time reference. Relative source-path phase remains; no exact causal delay/onset claim.
Known shape width/length/hole dimensions are used. Unknown plate profile/footprint and hole centre are priors. Reference264mm width is literal published metadata, not silently corrected.
Sensitivity is declared one-at-a-time, without musical-note optimization. Offhole receiving positions stay fixed at the nominal half-hole axis while source hole location varies.

No back radiation, edge diffraction, capsule directionality, complete stereo array field, or broadband studio-position reconstruction is established. Complex-pole propagation is a local modal approximation.
